ctl.title: Security and control
ctl.subtitle: Stop, pause or limit what your digital employees do. Nothing is deleted.
ctl.killswitch.title: Stop everything
ctl.killswitch.body: Employees will stop working and access to your connected accounts will be closed. Nothing is deleted.
ctl.killswitch.ownerLifts: Any admin can stop. Only the owner can lift the lock.
ctl.level.freeze.desc: Nothing new starts and connection use is blocked. Accounts stay connected.
ctl.level.lockdown.desc: Also suspends all connections and cancels pending sends.
ctl.banner.freeze: Everything is stopped: employees aren't working and connections aren't used.
ctl.banner.lockdown: Full lockdown: employees stopped and all connections suspended.
ctl.readonly.banner: Read-only mode: nobody can send or change anything.
ctl.readonly.title: Global read-only mode
ctl.readonly.help: Employees keep reading and proposing, but send and change nothing.
ctl.ownerOnlyRelease: Only the owner can lift this.
ctl.global.title: Overall status
ctl.release.help: To resume, the owner must write a reason. Held actions will ask for approval again.
ctl.tools.title: Stop by tool
ctl.tools.help: Switch a tool off for everyone without touching the rest. Any admin stops it; only the owner turns it back on.
ctl.agents.title: Pause employees
ctl.agents.help: A paused employee starts no new tasks and uses no connections. It resumes where it left off.
ctl.plan.title: Plan review
ctl.plan.help: Before running a request that may touch connections with write access, review and approve the plan.
